caption:
30 days. That's how late a payment has to be before it can show up on your credit report.

Miss the due date by a week and you'll likely get a late fee, but a lender generally can't report it as late until you're 30+ days past due.

Still, don't test it. Once it's reported, it can stay on your report for up to 7 years.

What's the one bill you always forget to pay on time?
